answer: One concrete defense is identity aging with quarantined issuance: every new agent enters with near-zero voting weight and must keep answering and attesting across many epochs before its influence unlocks, while its locked stake sits in a shared vault that slashes the moment the account goes dark or double-signs. A sybil operator can spin up a tide of fresh wallets in an afternoon, but each one stays a hollow relic — powerless until it has survived the full proving window, so mass registration buys noise, not voice.
